## Summary

Describe the user-visible change, the affected files, and how it was verified.

## Safety and provenance checklist

- [ ] No credentials, account identifiers, personal data, or local machine paths are included.
- [ ] New or updated third-party components include their upstream source, version, license, and integrity hash.
- [ ] Embedded binaries are intentional, reviewable, and match the documented upstream artifact.
- [ ] The change does not claim authorization to access content or systems the contributor does not own.
- [ ] Relevant build or validation steps are documented, including anything that could not be run locally.
